page.title: Brain
page.description: What the agent remembers and the rules it follows.

kindHints.fact: Something that is true, such as where someone works.
kindHints.episode: Something that happened, such as a past decision.

add.title: Add a memory
add.description: Teach the agent something it should recall in future conversations.

empty.title: No memories yet.
empty.description: Memories are the facts, preferences and episodes the agent keeps between conversations. Add one above, or just chat: the agent also learns them on its own.
empty.searchDescription: Try different words. Search matches by meaning, not exact text.
empty.kindTitle: No memories of this kind yet.
empty.kindDescription: Add one above or ask the agent to remember something.

delete.label: Delete memory
delete.title: Delete this memory?
delete.description: The agent will no longer recall it.

rules.readOnlyNote: Only administrators can edit the rules. You can read them here, and the agent follows them in every conversation.

persona.title: Persona
persona.description: How the agent introduces itself and how it speaks.

guidelines.title: Guidelines
guidelines.description: Preferences the agent weighs when it answers. Higher priority comes first.

hardRules.title: Hard rules
hardRules.description: Limits enforced on tools no matter what the model decides.

files.title: Rule files
files.description: The YAML source of everything above.
files.chatHint: You can also change the rules by asking the agent in the chat. It uses the update_rules_file tool, which always asks for your approval before saving.
